ground_truth_use: only retrospective correctness and within-class summaries

definitions.top1_relation: first relation in the frozen Consensus-Margin ordering
definitions.consensus_votes: number of candidate relation experts predicting the consensus class
definitions.normalized_entropy: entropy of top-1 relation distribution divided by log(candidate relation count)
definitions.dominant_set_share: largest frequency of an unordered selected-Nr relation set
definitions.Jaccard: selected relation set versus frozen iKnow dataset relation set

caution: Relation-conditioned effects are descriptive because five selected relations co-occur; they must not be interpreted causally.
